PhD Admissions
One-on-One Mentorship. Global Impact.
Joining the collaborative research community at Duke ECE gives you amazing opportunities for a career in research and technology development.
Come to Duke and Durham, and get a PhD experience like no other.
Contact Admissions
How to Apply
Guaranteed Funding
PhD research at Duke is fully funded, and our students also receive conference and travel support.
See Details
Generous Stipend
Guaranteed pay, 12 months a year, for the first five years
Paid Tuition
Covered by Duke during the first five years of study
No Fees
For the first five years, Duke pays all mandatory fees
Insurance Coverage
For six years, Duke pays your health and dental premiums
Excellent Outcomes
More than 10 percent of recent graduates launched academic careers. About 75 percent found jobs in industry.
See the Data
World-Class Challenges
Duke prepares PhD graduates who can tackle the biggest challenges in machine learning, cyber-physical systems, smart sensing, metamaterials, quantum computing and more. As a Duke student, you’ll have the advantage of Duke’s renown research enterprise.
Signature Duke ECE Discoveries
Advancing AI
Print-on-demand electronics
Human-robot interactions in cyber-physical systems
Metamaterials, including humanity’s first true cloaking device
Quantum computing hardware and software
